notes: Milestone 2: shapes now arrive as editable AE shape layers: rectangles, ellipses, lines, polygons, stars, vectors and boolean shapes.
Fills and strokes are editable: colour, opacity, width, inside/outside alignment, caps, joins and dashes.
Figma groups and frames become nulls, with their layers parented to them.
Frames that clip their content become precomps (rounded corners are masked). Partly transparent groups become precomps too.
Text, shadows, blurs, gradients, image fills and masks still arrive as Figma-rendered images of just that piece. The report says which and why.
The Figma Reference layer is no longer squashed when a frame has a drop shadow.
After updating, close Frame Bridge in Figma and run it again. Until you do, it will say Update needed.
testFocus: Turn on the Figma Reference layer and check that every shape sits exactly on it, at Scale 1× and 2×.
Strokes: inside, outside, dashed and thick on curves. Rounded and per-corner rectangles. Pen-tool vectors with holes.
Groups arrive as nulls you can move; frames with Clip content arrive as precomps that clip like Figma.
Edit ▸ Undo removes the last frame completely, including its precomps and nulls.
